instruction: Run `C:\Users\user\Desktop\bjt_ref.cir` in native PSpice. Keep the native simulator artifacts as `C:\Users\user\Desktop\bjt_ref.out`, `C:\Users\user\Desktop\bjt_ref_measure.txt`, and `C:\Users\user\Desktop\bjt_ref.dat`. Then export the six native temperature points from `C:\Users\user\Desktop\bjt_ref_measure.txt` into `C:\Users\user\Desktop\t_curve.csv`. The CSV header must be `T_C,Vout_V`, and the rows must be listed in increasing temperature order. [Software] Launch OrCAD Capture with `C:\Cadence\SPB_24.1\tools\bin\capture.exe` (adjust to your Cadence install root).
